defs.def: a large sea fish with very sharp teeth and a pointed fin on its back. There are several types of shark, some of which can attack people swimming. 鲨鱼

ex.s: Parry quickly graduated from his early hearts and sharks, and started to surprise families with drawings that captured young patients’ personalities.
ex.t: 帕里很快从早期的心脏和鲨鱼中毕业,并开始用捕捉年轻患者人格的图画给家庭带来惊喜.

ex.s: Share what you know about sharks.
This is the opening scene from the 1975 film Jaws, showing a shark attack.
ex.t: 这是1975年电影"Jaws"的开场表演,展示了鲨鱼的攻击.

ex.s: It tells the story of a great white shark that attacks and kills swimmers.
ex.t: 它讲述了一只大白鲨攻击和杀死游泳者的故事.

ex.s: It strengthened people's long held idea of the great white shark as a dangerous animal.People have always been scared of sharks, but Jaws made things worse.
ex.t: 它强化了人们长期持有的将大白鲨视为危险动物的想法,人们总是害怕鲨鱼,但大白鲨却让事情变得更糟.

ex.s: It made people frightened of sharks, especially of the great white shark.
ex.t: 它使人们害怕鲨鱼,特别是大白鲨.

defs.def: a person who is dishonest in business, especially sb who gives bad advice and gets people to pay too much for sth 坑蒙拐骗的人；诈骗者
